instructions_to_main_agent: Do not break any existing testids or routes. Maintain all existing Portuguese text.
Replace the current gold color scheme globally with the new blue/emerald high-tech palette.
Update the app layout to use a left icon-rail sidebar (w-20, icons only, small 3D cube logo) instead of a top nav or wide sidebar.
Add a radial blue glow behind the main content area in the global layout.
Implement the HUGE ghosted/translucent watermark heading behind page titles using the 'watermark_heading' class specifications.
Update Recharts components: use the defined `<defs>` gradients and line colors (Blue and Emerald). Add confidence shaded bands to forecast charts.
Redesign the Alert cards on the right to use simple left-aligned colored dots (emerald/amber/red) instead of heavy backgrounds, maintaining glassy surface logic.
For the Chat UI, apply the specific `border-l-2 border-blue-500` accent for the CEO reply and solid `bg-blue-600` for the user reply.
For the Reports screen, use the 'reports_screen' card definitions with the top accent border lines (blue/emerald/slate).
Update the global `.surface` utility to match the glassy `bg-white/[0.02] border-white/[0.08]` spec and ensure all cards use it.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (e.g. bg-white/[0.04]) and subtle transitions.
Make sure background is extremely dark, near-black (#05050A).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
